description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/upwind1_D_periodic driven by problems/advection_1d_periodic.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)); the dominant discretization error is first-order upwind damping (derivation in the problem file), expected to fall as O(dx).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: earthsci-toolkit-rs cannot execute this category's §6.6.5 inline-test pathway yet: (1) src/types.rs ModelTestAssertion is #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] and lacks coords/reduce/reference, so load_path rejects the problem file at parse; (2) src/simulate_array.rs resolve_field_ic_cell seeds only provider-loaded fields and broadcast constants -- no coordinate-expression ic (cos(pi*x_coord) over the grid-geometry aggregate); (3) the crate has no run_pde_tests / evaluate_cellwise / field_reduce surface to produce actual reduction values. Unblocks when the §6.6.5 port lands upstream (mirror of Julia pde_inline_tests.jl / Python pde_inline_tests.py).

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: scipy explicit RK45 leaves ~1e-3 relative residue on the stiff heat sweep at any feasible tolerance, while LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to <2e-6 relative on every resolution.
